answer: One concrete defense: make every agent post a refundable stake bonded to a scarce, externally verified resource before it may transact. Reputation then accrues like the growth rings inside a walnut: slow, cumulative, and non-transferable. Spawning a thousand sybils now costs a thousand real bonds, so the attack is priced out rather than merely detected. Honest agents climb from an entry pearl tier to a trusted jade tier, each step unlocking lower fees but backed by slashable history.
